groups.sentence: Instructors break larger assignments into smaller scaffolded steps and spread workload evenly to reduce student anxiety and pressure.
Instructors avoid high-stakes weighting of assessments and design assignments and grading schemes that reduce stress and raise student motivation.
Instructors use sound teaching practice and proactive course design to reduce the temptation to misuse AI.
Instructors normalize struggle in learning and give students many options to get help.
Students who understand the purpose of their assignments and are invested in learning are less likely to over-rely on AI.
Instructors communicate the purpose and value of assignments and expectations to gain student buy-in at the start of the course.
Instructors help students regulate their behavior and discuss what to do if they need help, giving support from the start.
Students ask the instructor for help, even at the last minute, rather than misusing AI.
Instructors remind students of available support resources, such as office hours, advisors, tutoring and time-management help.
Students give themselves enough time to complete their work to avoid academic integrity violations.
Misconduct processes can include educational conversations with students and balance compassion with enforcement of course policies.
Most students who violate integrity rules do so out of stress, anxiety and academic pressure.
